name: Yagami Yukino
source:
A miko and Satoshi's childhood friend a year younger than him, the two always played together when they were kids.

Since she hasn't anything to do aside from her duties as a miko, she often helps out at the inn. She has a bright personality for which she is loved by both adults and children. Yukino loves her life in the village and wants to live in the village for the rest of her life.

Although she doesn't show it, Yukino easily gets lonely. When Satoshi was leaving the village she has obediently seen him off, but then felt quite depressed for a while.
